lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Four hundred and one out of that sand in eleven days. Every one the same outline. Same man, same length of rebar, same stop at the same forty metres.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It is not one man. It is a great many men, standing in the same place, doing the same thing at the same moment — and the ground has kept the moment rather than the men.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Then somebody buried a crew out there. And the ground's been trying to give them back ever since. I'd want to know whose crew before I went down.
